summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its second-quarter FY2026 earnings release for the period ended April 30, 2026. The filing reports record revenue of $179.3 million and adjusted EBITDA of $13.9 million, along with operational updates such as a $40 million credit facility from Bank of Montreal and membership growth in its Canadian Cabana Club. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is announced. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report, not a special situation.
